Title: Public preview: Microsoft Operations Management Suite Linux log analytics

Body.Content:
Whether you have Windows Server-based or Linux-based workloads, Microsoft Operations Management Suite can help you deliver the service agility and protection your business demands. The Operations Management Suite agent for Linux is available in public preview. The code is open source. The agent works with a VM, on bare-metal, or on hosts deployed in a cloud. Onboarding a Linux host into the system is accomplished in a few clicks. You can specify what logs to collect and ingest alerts from Nagios and Zabbix. Increase your ability to derive actionable insights from your machine data and solve problems faster.
  • Onboard your Windows Server and Linux hosts from the Operations Management Suite website.
  • For more information, please visit the Hybrid Cloud IT Management Blog.
